summary: The latest discussions focus on extending Parquet’s type system with a logical VECTOR type that uses metadata to enforce fixed‑length constraints, and on a new versioning scheme that distinguishes add‑everywhere changes from compatibility‑level changes to accelerate feature rollout while preserving reader correctness.

highlights.text: Logical VECTOR type proposal uses metadata constraints (MIN_LENGTH/MAX_LENGTH) instead of new physical types.

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Numeric Vector type: physical representation (outcome of focused call)

highlights.text: Versioning proposal introduces add‑everywhere and compatibility level categories to speed feature rollout.
